data.name: F.A.R.M.S.: Chill Factory
data.detailed_description:
『F.A.R.M.S.: Chill Factory』 is a factory automation simulation game you can enjoy at your own pace.

Build complex production lines, optimize efficiency, and accelerate production through upgrades. There are no enemy attacks to worry about and no harsh time limits. It is just you, a vast factory, and endless possibilities unlocked through technological research.

🏭 Flexible Factory Design

Design the factory of your dreams with intuitive controls.

With the Link System, you can complete production lines simply by dragging connections between machine ports. No more struggling with direction restrictions.

By using Relays, you can route around obstacles and create clean, beautiful connections. Batch editing tools also let you move or delete multiple machines at once, making large-scale layout changes stress-free.

🌲 Evolve Your Factory with the Tech Tree

Invest the items you produce and the money you earn to unlock the Tech Tree.

From unlocking new production machines to upgrading existing ones, increasing conveyor belt speed, and expanding useful system features, the path of growth is yours to choose.

Enjoy the satisfaction of building up your factory step by step into a more advanced and efficient industrial giant.

🔫 Produce Rare Resources with Void Harvesting

Void Harvesting is a production machine with tower-defense-style mechanics.

Use surplus materials to power Turrets, defeat Void entities heading toward the Beacon, and produce rare resources.

Void entities will not destroy your factory or stop your production lines.

As an extension of your usual factory building, set up defensive lines and aim for a stable supply of rare resources.

🍣 From Iron Ingots... to Sushi!?

Advance your technology and unlock new recipes.

You will not be limited to heavy industrial products. In addition to classic items like automobile parts and construction materials, you can also produce Cake made from grown wheat, and even fresh Sushi!

Manage a wide variety of production chains and build a manufacturing hub that can meet every kind of demand.

Key Features

  • Stress-Free Automation: No enemy raids. Just a relaxed, "chill" gameplay experience.

  • Flexible Network Building: Create free-form lines using Relays (Waypoints) without worrying about conveyor directions.

  • Tech Tree Progression: A deep progression system where you invest resources to gradually unlock and strengthen machines and features.

  • Active Intervention: Control factory productivity directly by clicking to Boost.

  • Unique Products: Manufacture a wide range of items, from pistons and construction kits to sweets and sushi.

Now, build the world's best factory with the power of automation and your strategy!

Unlock new tech via the Tech Tree, boost production with your clicks, and manufacture everything from iron to sushi in your ultimate factory!
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (Quad Core recommended)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card (Intel UHD Graphics 630 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
